messages:
Lina: Quick morning update from the overnight microbench + ops smoke for Pulse9b-int6. I pushed a tiny slice-run and computed a UnitEconIndex for triage.
Rafael: Nice 64 curious numbers. paste?
Lina: sure, pasted from bench run:
```
model: pulse9b-int6
cost_per_1m_tokens: $420
baseline (pulse9b-fp16) cost_per_1m_tokens: $1100
net_savings_pct: 61.8%
quality_gap_overall: -1.2pp (avg on chat-summaries + intent)
quality_drop_longdoc: -3.1pp (recall slice)
p95_latency: 190ms (short), 340ms (long-doc, cold KVCache)
UnitEconIndex: 0.82  # higher is better; combines savings, quality retention, latency tail
```
Zoe: 0.82 looks solid for UI surfaces. But long-doc recall is a concern. Did hallucination/faithfulness move?
Lina: faithfulness delta +0.7pp on the recall slice. Hallucination regex flags minimal on synthetic tests.
Nikhil: Ops note: GPU utilization on int6 was 0.68 avg, scaling stable. Cold-starts cause the long-doc tail. Could mitigate with warmstart and prefetching.
Rafael: Product asks: can we capture most savings without jeopardizing GTN/regulatory slices?
Lina: My suggestion: create a holdback set for high-risk slices (gtm_gtn, legal_search, billing_verif). Route rest through pulse.int6.hybrid with 65/35 split initially.
Zoe: For thresholds, I propose fallback to baseline if slice delta >1.5pp sustained for 15m or if UnitEconIndex drops below 0.70.
Nikhil: I'll add the routing flag and emergency fallback to infra. Name it pulse.hybrid.v2, params: {
  "split": 0.65,
  "holdbacks": ["gtm_gtn","legal_search","billing_verif"],
  "fallback_window_mins": 15,
  "quality_drop_pp_threshold": 1.5
}
Lina: I'll run 3 priming variants for the recall slice: (A) longer context priming, (B) recall-prompt-v2 (explicit anchors), (C) warmstart + prefix cache. Will post results by EOD.
Rafael: Please include a tiny AB plan to sample 5% of gtn traffic to int6 after priming success for final validation before broader rollout.
Zoe: Also recommend adding a micro-eval: 200 GTN-critical prompts + human rating; need <1.0pp gap to consider moving GTN.
bench-bot: microbench finished: 6308743211 -> 6308743190. All runs completed. Long-doc KVC miss rate noted at 18%.
Lina: TL;DR for PMs: int6 cuts token cost ~62%, modest overall quality hit (~1.2pp), visible recall regression on long-doc. Recommended path: hybrid routing with holdbacks + priming and cache mitigation, micro-eval on GTN before shifting critical traffic.
Rafael: Great. I'll sync with PMs and legal. Assign owners?
Lina: Owners: Lina (priming experiments & micro-eval), Nikhil (routing flag + infra fallback), Zoe (human eval coordination), Rafael (PM communication).
Nikhil: I'll roll the flag to staging tonight with the 65/35 default.
Lina: Thanks 64 will post the priming results and upload full slice CSV to the scorecard shortly.
Rafael: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
